Program_Info.Program_Description_2000: PromoShot is a layer editor for promo video. Record screen or camera, import media, arrange layers on a timeline, then keyframe position, scale, rotation, opacity, color, and more. Export video, stills, or GIF. Made for app makers, creators, founders, and marketers who want a real editor without a subscription. Free exports carry a watermark; PromoShot Pro removes it, one time. Mac now; iPhone and iPad open the same .promo folder. Automation / MCP on Mac. Open-source Rust engine on GitHub (GarAlex/promoshot). App Store id 6770157576. Site: https://promoshot.app. Unrelated to other App Store apps named PromoShot.
Program_Info.Program_Description_250: Layer editor for promo video on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Keyframe layers, export video/stills/GIF. Free with watermark; one-time Pro. promoshot.app
Program_Info.Program_Description_450: PromoShot turns screen recordings, video, photos, and captions into promo assets on a timeline. Free watermarked exports; one-time Pro removes it. Mac, iPhone, iPad. https://promoshot.app
